AboutPage.metaTitle: About CAURIS DIGITAL — Digital Incubator, Yaoundé, Cameroon
AboutPage.metaDescription: Discover CAURIS DIGITAL, its history, mission and the team supporting African tech entrepreneurs from Yaoundé, with online mentorship worldwide.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: An African incubator built by Africans, for Africans — and open to the whole world.
AboutPage.storyTitle: The incubator born from a simple observation
AboutPage.storyParagraph1: CAURIS DIGITAL was born from a simple observation: Africa is full of tech talent, brilliant ideas and courageous entrepreneurs. What's missing is a structured ecosystem to help them grow.
AboutPage.storyParagraph2: Founded in Yaoundé, at the heart of Cameroon, CAURIS DIGITAL was created to fill that gap. Our name is a symbol: the cauri shell, which served as currency across Africa for centuries, represents value, connection and exchange — exactly what we facilitate between entrepreneurs, mentors, investors and markets.
AboutPage.storyParagraph3: Since our creation, we have supported dozens of entrepreneurs in Fintech, Agritech, Edtech and Healthtech. Our hybrid model — local roots in Yaoundé, mentorship accessible online worldwide — lets us reach founders in Douala, Dakar, Abidjan, Kinshasa, Paris or Montreal, without compromising on quality of support.
AboutPage.storyParagraph4: We draw inspiration from the world's best incubators — Centech in Montreal, Y Combinator in San Francisco, Station F in Paris — to build something unique: an incubation model calibrated for African realities, with solutions designed for African markets.
AboutPage.historyImageAlt: Team of African entrepreneurs in a collaborative session
AboutPage.missionCalloutText: Boost digital entrepreneurship in Francophone Africa by training, incubating and connecting tomorrow's tech entrepreneurs — from concept to product launch.
AboutPage.visionTitle: An Africa that produces — not just consumes — tech
AboutPage.visionText: Making Francophone Africa a continent that produces global technology solutions — not just a consumer of imported technology.
AboutPage.valuesTitle: Six principles that guide every decision
AboutPage.teamDescription: Professionals who have themselves started, built, failed and succeeded — before putting themselves at the service of others.

amina.quote: CAURIS DIGITAL isn't just an incubator. It's a family. In six months, I turned a vague idea into a product that customers actually pay for. Online mentoring let me keep going from Douala without leaving my job.

jeanPaul.quote: What struck me most was the quality of the mentors. Professionals who actually built companies. Not just theorists. Thanks to their network, I landed my first corporate client by week 8 of the program.

rodrigue.quote: I'm based in Brazzaville. Joining CAURIS DIGITAL online felt risky. In reality, the program was even more structured than I expected. Today my app has 12,000 active users.

IncubationPage.metaTitle: Incubation Program — CAURIS DIGITAL | 6 months to launch your tech startup
IncubationPage.metaDescription: Join CAURIS DIGITAL's 6-month incubation program. Mentorship, resources, network, and support to launch your tech startup from Africa.
IncubationPage.heroSubtitle: to turn your idea into a company.
IncubationPage.heroImageAlt: African entrepreneur working during the incubation program
IncubationPage.presentationTitle: A free, intensive, and human program
IncubationPage.presentationParagraph1: CAURIS DIGITAL's Incubation program is our founding program. It is designed for tech project leaders who have an idea, a team (or the beginnings of one), and the conviction that their solution can change something — in Africa and beyond.
IncubationPage.presentationParagraph2: Over 6 months, you benefit from structured, personalized support: group workshops, one-on-one mentoring sessions, access to our partner network, a collaborative workspace, and a community of entrepreneurs who support each other.
IncubationPage.noEquity: does not take any equity stake.
IncubationPage.presentationParagraph3End: Our investment is the time, expertise, and network we put at your service.
IncubationPage.benefitsTitle: Everything you need to go from idea to market
IncubationPage.timelineDescription: Six months structured into three progressive phases — from clarifying the problem to Demo Day.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.description: Clarifying the problem and the solution. Market validation (customer interviews, field research). Building the business model. First prototypes or MVP. Workshops: Design Thinking, Lean Startup, Business Model Canvas.

building.title: Building
building.description: Product or service development. First test users. Rapid iterations based on feedback. Team building. Workshops: product management, business development, communication.

launch.title: Going to market
launch.description: Go-to-market strategy. First revenue or contracts. Investor pitch preparation. Building the fundraising deck. Demo Day: public presentation in front of investors and partners.

IncubationPage.profileIntro: We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for conviction, rigor, and potential. Here are the criteria we evaluate:
profileCriteria: You have a tech startup idea with market potential in Africa or internationally
You have (or are looking for) a complementary team — technical, business, or both
You are available to commit seriously for 6 months
You are open to feedback, even difficult feedback, and ready to pivot if needed
Your project fits one of our priority sectors (Agritech, Fintech, Edtech, Healthtech, Smart Cities)
You are based in French-speaking Africa or willing to interact in French
IncubationPage.remoteNote: Candidates outside Yaoundé can participate entirely online. No physical travel is required. The full program is accessible remotely through our online mentoring platform.
IncubationPage.goodToKnowText: Whether you're in Dakar, Abidjan, Lomé, Kinshasa, Paris, or Montreal, you can join the program from home. Our asynchronous mentoring platform plus live sessions guarantees the same quality of support, wherever you are.

testimonial1.name: [First Last]
testimonial1.quote: I applied from Brazzaville, not knowing if it would work remotely. The program showed me that mentorship quality doesn't depend on geography. I had access to the same resources as those in Yaoundé.

testimonial2.name: [First Last]
testimonial2.quote: The highlight: Demo Day. Presenting to real investors, with a real product and real customers — after just 6 months. I never thought I'd get there so fast without CAURIS DIGITAL.

IncubationPage.applyDescription: From submitting your application to launching the program — in less than a month.

step2.title: Step 2 — Interview

step4.title: Step 4 — Launch
step4.description: Program launch. Group orientation day (online or in person) and start of mentoring sessions.

CorporatePage.metaTitle: Corporate Innovation — CAURIS DIGITAL | Co-innovate with African startups
CorporatePage.metaDescription: CAURIS DIGITAL supports large companies in their open innovation strategy in Africa. Scouting, co-creation, and pilots with the best African tech startups.
CorporatePage.heroSubtitle: Connect your company to the most promising African tech startups. Access tomorrow's innovation — today.
CorporatePage.whyUsParagraph1: Africa is the world's fastest-growing continent. Its markets are undergoing a full digital transformation. Its startups are developing radically new solutions — often better suited to local constraints than imported products.
CorporatePage.whyUsParagraph2End: By becoming a corporate partner, your company gains access to a steady flow of selected startups, co-development opportunities, and a strong position in Africa's digital economy.
CorporatePage.whyUsParagraph3: We work with large companies, banks, telecom operators, NGOs, and international organizations looking to innovate in Africa — without starting from scratch.
CorporatePage.servicesDescription: Five tailor-made offerings to power your open innovation strategy in Africa.

scouting.title: Technology scouting
scouting.description: We identify the African startups most relevant to your strategic challenges. Market analysis, mapping of players, shortlisting, and direct introductions.

coCreation.title: Co-creation programs
coCreation.description: We organize co-innovation workshops between your teams and our startups. Design sprints, targeted hackathons, problem-solving workshops with agile, creative entrepreneurs.

pilots.title: Pilots and POCs
pilots.description: We facilitate concrete experiments between your company and our startups. A well-scoped pilot, with clear objectives, a defined budget, and rigorous follow-up. Zero unnecessary bureaucracy.

reverseMentoring.title: Reverse mentoring program
reverseMentoring.description: Your senior executives become mentors to our startups — and in return, they're exposed to the agile practices, new technologies, and disruptive business models our entrepreneurs are developing.

openInnovationDay.description: An annual event organized by CAURIS DIGITAL bringing together startups, corporates, investors, and institutions around African tech challenges. Pitches, panel discussions, networking, and partnership announcements.

donnees-collectees.title: 1. Data collected
donnees-collectees.content: We collect the personal data you voluntarily provide through our forms (first name, last name, email, country, message). We also collect anonymized browsing data via Google Analytics 4 (pages visited, session duration, traffic source) to improve the site.

finalite.title: 2. Purpose of collection
finalite.content: Form data is used exclusively to: respond to your requests, process your program applications, and send you the newsletter if you have subscribed. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

duree.title: 3. Retention period

droits.title: 4. Your rights
droits.content: In accordance with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and object to your data.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.content: We use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) and functional cookies to improve your browsing experience. You can decline non-essential cookies via the consent banner shown on your first visit.

IntroBlock.title: The epicenter of digital innovation at the heart of Francophone Africa
IntroBlock.paragraph1: CAURIS DIGITAL propels high-potential technology innovation projects, providing entrepreneurs with a complete ecosystem of resources, tools, training and connections — supporting them from concept to product launch.
IntroBlock.paragraph2: Our incubator operates from Yaoundé, the economic and technological capital of Cameroon, deeply rooted in African realities. Thanks to our fully online mentorship program, we support project leaders across Francophone Africa, Europe and beyond. Geography is no longer a barrier to excellence.
IntroBlock.paragraph3: We believe Africa doesn't need to import innovation. It builds it, here, now, with its own codes, its own markets and its own solutions.
